messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we have the AtlasPay health review scheduled for Wed Apr 6 10:00 AM PT (exec slot). Need final slide deck, renewal-risk assessment, and a clear exec ask. Can folks confirm owners by EOD today?

Elliot: I can own the technical health slide (latency, token cost trends, tail-case notes). Will include a short perf heatmap.

Sam: I’ll take adoption metrics + enablement checklist. Will assemble DAU, feature usage, and one slide for recommended enablement actions. ETA: EOD.

Harper: I’ll draft the renewal risk assessment (risk level, triggers, mitigations). @Nina can you share the latest CSAT and any outstanding blockers so I can quantify impact?

Nina: Shared notes in the customer doc: https://redwood.internal/atlaspay/feedback (internal). CSAT (30d): 78%. Top blockers: occasional long-prompt tail latency spikes, plus an onboarding backlog for the ML infra team. Adding a couple of verbatim customer quotes.

Maya: Thanks. We also need a one-slide "exec ask" framing two options: conservative (short-term hosted extension + SLA) vs aggressive (migrate to Dedicated in Q3). @Elliot — can you give a ballpark cost delta for 1M tokens/mo sustained? Don’t need exact $$, just relative savings and assumptions.

Elliot: Ballpark: Dedicated usually saves ~30–40% on unit cost at steady 1M tokens/mo, depending on quantization and batch gains. I’ll add assumptions: 8x batching improvements and prefix/KV cache hit of ~20%.

Sam: Enablement checklist draft: 1) runbook handover 2) onboarding workshop for ML infra 3) weekly ops sync invite 4) documentation transfer. I’ll also build a 5-min run-of-show for the call.

CS Bot: Calendar invite updated: AtlasPay Health Review — Wed Apr 6 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maya, Elliot, Sam, Harper, AtlasPay execs, Sales (Jordan).

Maya: Need two concise sets of exec asks (conservative vs aggressive) with pros/cons and key timelines. Harper, can you draft the pros/cons bullets and a target decision date?

Harper: Will do. Draft by 2pm. Also flagging renewal window: contract auto-renews 2024-09-15, so we need final recommendation by mid-August to allow procurement lead time. I’ll add a milestone timeline to the deck.

Sam: Linking internal onboarding slides: /assets/onboarding/atlaspay_onboard_v2.pptx — will extract two slides for the deck.

Nina: I’ll paste two customer quotes and a short CSAT trend sparkline into the deck. Current risk: MEDIUM — if latency issues persist, move to HIGH.

Maya: Action-items recap in-thread:
- Maya: consolidate final deck, run-of-show, lead exec ask
- Elliot: perf & cost slides + assumptions
- Sam: adoption metrics, enablement checklist, runbook extract
- Harper: renewal risk slide + timeline/gantt
- Nina: CSAT, quotes, blocker list

Goal: circulating a near-final deck by 4pm today, final by 1pm day-of. :thumbsup:

Elliot: :thumbsup: noted.

Sam: If anyone wants to add a metric, drop it in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood/atlas-health

Harper: I’ll add the milestone gantt and can present the timeline.

Maya: Who will handle Q&A? Proposal: Maya lead exec ask + high-level Qs, Elliot for tech deep-dive, Harper for contract/timeline. Agree?

Nina: Agree.

CS Bot: Reminder set: deck due Apr 6 1:00 PM PT.
